properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 7 at 6:34AM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description: ...The National Weather Service in Tampa Bay Ruskin has issued a Flood Warning for the following rivers in Florida...  Withlacoochee At US 41 Dunnellon affecting Levy, Marion and Citrus Counties.  .Elevated water levels continue on the Withlacoochee River at Dunnellon due to  excessive hydrilla growth along a 4.5 mile stretch of river between U.S. 41 and Lake Rousseau. The hydrilla has been acting like a dam and holding water back, keeping levels elevated. Water levels are expected to remain steady or gradually rise as rainfall occurs in the basin over the next few days.* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.  * WHERE...Withlacoochee at US 41 Dunnellon.  * WHEN...From this morning until further notice.  * IMPACTS...At 28.2 feet, Docks and boat ramps flood along the river in Citrus and Marion counties.  * ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 5:45 AM EDT Wednesday the stage was 28.2 feet. - Bankfull stage is 28.2 feet. - Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending at 5:45 AM EDT Wednesday was 28.2 feet. - Forecast...The river is expected to remain steady above flood stage at 28.2 feet. - Flood stage is 28.2 feet. - Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 28.3 feet on 10/05/1965. - https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 6 at 9:45PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description: ...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...  St Johns River Near Astor affecting Volusia and Lake Counties.  .The St Johns River at Astor is forecast to continue a steady rise through this week due to northerly winds and repeated rounds of heavy rainfall across the basin.  For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Minor flooding is forecast.* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.  * WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.  * WHEN...Until further notice.  * IMPACTS...At 2.8 feet, Docks and boat ramps covered at South Moon Fish Camp and approaching sea wall at Blair's Jungle Den. Water approaching sites closest to the river at Fish Tales RV Resort and Astor Landing Campground. Portion of Clair Street covered by river water south of the Butler Boat Ramp. Docks underwater at the Astor Bridge Marina and along Riveredge Drive. Portions of Fox Road are covered with water nearest to the river. Acorn, Hazelnut and Redbud roads are underwater with yards inundated.  * ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 8:30 PM EDT Tuesday the stage was 2.4 feet. - Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet. - Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending at 8:30 PM EDT Tuesday was 2.4 feet. - Forecast...The river is forecast to continue rising through through minor flood stage, reaching 2.7 feet late this week. - Flood stage is 2.3 feet. - Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 2.6 feet on 10/14/1996. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
